caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden figurine of a bird, resembling a rooster or a turkey, placed centrally on a plain background. The bird stands on an oval base that features brown, tan, and beige tones, suggestive of carved wood. The body of the bird is predominantly light brown, with brush strokes and markings in yellow, green, red, and blue spread across its surface and wings, simulating feathers and decorative patterns. The tail is large and fan-shaped with visible carved lines radiating outward, shaded in brown and yellow with sporadic colored spots. The bird's head is upright, featuring a simple comb and beak that are lightly accented with red and brown. The entire composition is rendered on a neutral, off-white background with no additional objects or scenery, focusing the view entirely on the painted bird figurine.
title: Wooden Chicken
